theory.intro: A flow network can be given as a table instead of a diagram. Each row is the vertex an edge starts **from**, each column is the vertex it goes **to**, and the entry is that edge's capacity.
facts: An entry in row $A$, column $B$ gives the capacity of the directed edge from $A$ to $B$.

Follow the table's stated convention for entries representing no connection. A dash or a blank entry can mean there is no edge in that direction; the booklet also explicitly uses $0$ to mean no connection.
The table of a flow network **need not be symmetric**: an edge in one direction does not require an edge of the same capacity in the opposite direction.
The **source** is the vertex whose column contains only entries representing no connection under the table's stated convention, since no edge is directed into it.
The **sink** is the vertex whose row contains only entries representing no connection under the table's stated convention, since no edge is directed out of it.
Only the edges, their directions and their capacities matter; where a vertex sits on the page does not.
Draw every edge with a mid-line arrowhead so its direction is clear at a glance.
steps: Identify the source and the sink from the table
Draw and label a vertex for each row and column heading
Draw a directed edge for each entry representing a connection under the table's stated convention
Write each edge's capacity beside it

workedExamples.question_text:
The table gives pipe capacities in kL/h. A dash means no connection.
$\begin{array}{c|cccc}\text{From / To}&A&B&C&D\\\hline A&-&-&-&-\\B&9&-&-&-\\C&-&7&-&11\\D&8&-&-&-\end{array}$
Identify the source and sink, then draw the weighted directed flow network.

workedExamples.solution_text:
Record each edge in the row of the vertex it leaves and the column of the vertex it enters.
Row $P$ records $P\to Q$ and $P\to T$. Row $Q$ records $Q\to T$. Row $R$ records $R\to P$ and $R\to Q$. No edge leaves $T$.
$\begin{array}{c|cccc}\text{From / To}&P&Q&R&T\\\hline P&-&5&-&10\\Q&-&-&-&14\\R&16&12&-&-\\T&-&-&-&-\end{array}$
The source $R$ is drawn on the right; arrow directions determine the entries, regardless of vertex position. Capacities remain in tonnes per hour.

foundation.question_text:
The table gives the capacities of the one-way links in a network.
$\begin{array}{c|ccccc} \text{From / To} & S & A & B & C & T \\ \hline S & - & 12 & 9 & - & - \\ A & - & - & 5 & 8 & - \\ B & - & - & - & - & 14 \\ C & - & - & - & - & 7 \\ T & - & - & - & - & - \end{array}$
Draw the weighted directed flow network.

The table gives the capacities of the one-way links in a flow network.
$\begin{array}{c|ccccc} \text{From / To} & P & Q & R & U & V \\ \hline P & - & - & - & 6 & - \\ Q & 9 & - & 11 & - & - \\ R & - & - & - & 7 & - \\ U & - & - & - & - & 13 \\ V & - & - & - & - & - \end{array}$
Draw the weighted directed flow network.

foundation.solution_text:
Each edge is recorded once, in the row of the vertex it leaves and the column of the vertex it enters.
$\begin{array}{c|ccccc} \text{From / To} & S & A & B & C & T \\ \hline S & - & 11 & 16 & - & - \\ A & - & - & 6 & 8 & - \\ B & - & - & - & - & 19 \\ C & - & - & - & - & 13 \\ T & - & - & - & - & - \end{array}$

development.question_text:

The table gives the maximum number of parcels per hour each one-way route can carry.
$\begin{array}{c|cccccc} \text{From / To} & W & P & Q & R & U & Z \\ \hline W & - & 55 & 40 & - & - & - \\ P & - & - & 18 & 30 & - & - \\ Q & - & - & - & - & 48 & - \\ R & - & - & - & - & - & 26 \\ U & - & - & - & - & - & 60 \\ Z & - & - & - & - & - & - \end{array}$

development.solution_text:
The table has six capacities and five edges are already drawn.
The entry $8$ sits in row $A$, column $B$.
Complete the diagram by drawing an edge from $A$ to $B$ with a mid-line arrowhead pointing towards $B$ and capacity $8$ beside it.

development.question_text:
A flow network is recorded in this table.
The rows are listed in alphabetical order, not in the order material travels.
$\begin{array}{c|ccccc} \text{From / To} & A & B & C & D & E \\ \hline A & - & - & - & - & - \\ B & 7 & - & - & - & 13 \\ C & - & 21 & - & 16 & - \\ D & - & - & - & - & 9 \\ E & 24 & - & - & - & - \end{array}$
Draw the weighted directed flow network, with the source at the left and the sink at the right.

development.solution_text:
Each edge is recorded once, in the row of the vertex it leaves and the column of the vertex it enters. Where the vertices are drawn on the page makes no difference to the table.
$\begin{array}{c|cccccc} \text{From / To} & G & H & J & K & L & M \\ \hline G & - & - & - & - & - & - \\ H & 14 & - & - & - & - & - \\ J & 8 & - & - & - & - & - \\ K & - & 9 & - & - & - & - \\ L & - & 6 & 12 & - & - & - \\ M & - & - & - & 11 & 15 & - \end{array}$
